requirement.original: travel-planner的html生成机制修改一下设计，meal，attraction等等的每一个大项目只占一行，超出的内容加一个scrollbar用户可以scroll。同时每一个卡片都要同一个设计同一个大小。具体的设计你可以召唤UI设计师先consult一下。可以使用的样本是https://travel.life-ai.app/china/2026-04-12/
requirement.clarified: Redesign the travel plan HTML generation so each major category (meals, attractions, entertainment, shopping, accommodation, transportation) occupies a single horizontal row. Overflow content gets a horizontal scrollbar. All cards must have uniform design and size. Consult UI designer for specific design decisions. Reference sample: https://travel.life-ai.app/china/2026-04-12/
requirement.what: Convert category card layouts from wrapping grid/vertical stack to single-row horizontal scroll with uniform card sizes
requirement.why: Current layout is inconsistent: meals wrap to multiple rows, attractions/entertainment/shopping use a 2-column vertical stack. User wants a clean, uniform horizontal browsing experience per category.

included: All category sections: meals, attractions, entertainment, shopping, accommodation, transportation
CSS activity-grid in html_generator.py for bucket-list pages
excluded: Data model or JSON schema changes
Image fetching or data loading logic

success_criteria: Every category section renders items in a single horizontal row (no wrapping)
Horizontal scrollbar appears when items overflow viewport width
All cards within each category have identical width and height
Cards maintain consistent visual design across categories
Layout works on both desktop and mobile viewports
Both generators (interactive React and bucket-list HTML) updated consistently
constraints: Must preserve existing click handlers (onItemClick, onBudgetClick)
Must preserve responsive breakpoint logic (sm/md/lg via useBreakpoint())
Must not change data loading or JSON schema
Must consult UI designer (frontend-design skill) for specific card dimensions and visual design before implementation
Single-file HTML output format must be maintained (no external CSS/JS files)

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Category cards wrap to multiple rows and have inconsistent sizes across meals, attractions, entertainment, shopping sections
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: N/A - this is a design change request, not a bug fix
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Original layout used CSS grid auto-fill/auto-fit which wraps by design, and a 2-column layout for attractions vs entertainment/shopping
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Wrapping creates uneven visual weight per category; 2-column layout groups unrelated categories together; card sizes vary by category type

context.codebase_state: Clean working tree on master branch

scripts/generate-html-interactive.py.description: Interactive React travel plan generator (~3100 lines). KanbanView component at line 2110 renders day content with inline JSX styles. Meals grid at line 2174, attractions+right-column 2-col grid at line 2220.

key_patterns.attractions_layout: display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: sm ? '1fr' : '1fr 1fr' -- attractions left, entertainment/shopping/accommodation right
key_patterns.card_sizing: No fixed dimensions -- cards auto-size based on content
key_patterns.responsive: useBreakpoint() hook returns sm/md/lg, used throughout

scripts/lib/html_generator.py.description: Reusable HTML generator for bucket-list and itinerary types (~3100 lines). CSS at top, JS rendering functions at bottom.

key_patterns.activity_grid_css: .activity-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: var(--space-md); }
key_patterns.activity_card_css: .activity-card { background: var(--color-primary); padding: var(--space-md); border-radius: var(--radius-md); border-left: 4px solid var(--color-accent); }
key_patterns.render_functions: renderDayContent() and renderCityContent() both emit <div class='activity-grid'> containers with <div class='activity-card'> children

dependencies.react: Loaded via CDN (React 18, Babel standalone for JSX)
dependencies.css: All inline styles in interactive generator; CSS classes in html_generator.py

development_approach.strategy: 1) Consult UI designer (frontend-design skill) for card dimensions, spacing, and scrollbar styling. 2) Modify KanbanView in generate-html-interactive.py: replace grid layouts with flex nowrap + overflow-x auto, use fixed card dimensions. 3) Remove the 2-column attractions/right-column split -- make each category a full-width horizontal scroll row. 4) Update CSS in html_generator.py: change .activity-grid from grid to flex row with overflow. 5) Test with sample data and verify on live URL after deploy.
development_approach.validation_approach: 1) Generate HTML with generate-html.sh china. 2) Deploy and verify at travel.life-ai.app. 3) Check each category section renders as single horizontal row. 4) Verify horizontal scroll works when items overflow. 5) Measure card dimensions to confirm uniformity. 6) Test on mobile viewport.

research_findings.reason: Horizontal scroll card rows is a well-established UI pattern (Netflix, Spotify, app stores). Implementation via CSS flexbox nowrap + overflow-x is standard and well-understood. No research needed.

ui_designer_consultation.reason: User explicitly asked to consult UI designer for specific card design
questions_for_designer: What should the fixed card dimensions be (width x height) for desktop and mobile?
Should card images maintain a fixed aspect ratio or fixed pixel height?
What scrollbar style works best -- native thin scrollbar, custom styled, or hidden with arrows?
Should there be scroll-snap behavior (snap to card boundaries)?
How should card content be truncated when it exceeds the fixed card height?
Should there be visual indicators (fade, arrows) at row edges to signal scrollability?
